approved_differences.statement: No behavior difference is approved in this internal capability slice. Modern-versus-legacy response projections, authentication, path conversion and safe errors remain future operations-owned parity requirements.

forbidden_in_this_slice: HTTP controller, security matcher, role decision or rate limiter
portable question format or Chinese label projection inside catalog
image-path rewriting or response-envelope construction inside catalog
route parity delta or OpenAPI operation migration

catalog_application_contract.runtime_sql: one explicit fifteen-column SELECT from questions by q.id = :question_id

result_semantics.zero_id: queried and representable because the frozen legacy contract contains a readable zero-id row
result_semantics.negative_id: rejected by the application service before persistence
result_semantics.long_max_value: bound once and returns Optional.empty when absent
result_semantics.raw_text: options, answer, tags and image path are preserved byte-for-text without JSON parsing, alias mapping or path rewriting
result_semantics.nullable_columns: all schema-compatible nullable legacy columns remain null
result_semantics.failure: the original persistence exception propagates unchanged so operations can apply the reviewed HTTP policy

shared_authentication.valid_administrator_bearer_only: 302 Location /login because the global admin Web gate does not accept Bearer-only access
shared_authentication.ordinary_session_plus_valid_administrato: 302 Location /login because the Bearer header bypasses the Web-session branch of the global gate

shared_path_and_failure_semantics.unicode_decimal_digits: accepted by the legacy integer converter and can resolve an existing row
shared_path_and_failure_semantics.leading_zeroes: accepted and can resolve an existing row
shared_path_and_failure_semantics.missing_or_long_max: 404 JSON error not found after one question-detail SELECT
shared_path_and_failure_semantics.negative: 404 text/html from routing before question-detail SQL
shared_path_and_failure_semantics.beyond_signed_64_bit: 500 generic safe JSON after the database bind attempt
shared_path_and_failure_semantics.database_failure_accept_any: 500 fixed generic Chinese HTML error page

modern_projection.answer: legacy compatibility string derived from the raw answer: choice indexes become letters, multiple letters concatenate, booleans use the Chinese compatibility value, fills join with semicolons, and malformed or null input becomes empty
modern_projection.tags: a valid JSON array is joined with commas; malformed non-JSON text is preserved and null becomes an empty string
modern_projection.image_path: an existing JSON array remains array JSON text; a nonempty scalar or grouped-object text value is wrapped as one JSON-array string element; null or empty becomes [] and legacy upload prefixes remain
modern_projection.malformed_json: raw options and tags remain visible, the compatibility answer becomes empty, and scalar image text is wrapped rather than normalized

legacy_projection.image_path: normalized JSON text plus image_path_json and grouped image fields
legacy_projection.malformed_json: malformed options and tags project to empty lists while the raw catalog source remains untouched

cross_cutting_effects.route_specific_rate_limit: 10 per minute observed on both operations
cross_cutting_effects.allowed_runtime_effects: global session, identity and configuration reads remain outside the catalog primitive
cross_cutting_effects.golden_side_effect_assertion: the complete fifteen-column questions fingerprint remains unchanged before and after every case

invariants: The catalog capability reads only the catalog-owned questions table.
One non-negative invocation executes exactly one bound SELECT and no DML, DDL or TEMP operation.
All fifteen selected columns map to one immutable record without dropping malformed raw text or nullable values.
A historical zero-id row is representable; negative IDs are rejected before JDBC.
No HTTP authentication, PQF mapping, Chinese label, image rewrite or response envelope enters catalog.
Persistence failures remain untranslated at the catalog boundary.
The PostgreSQL 18.4 150,000-row evidence uses questions_pkey once for existing, missing and Long.MAX_VALUE observations with no TEMP blocks.
PostgreSQL 16.14 and 18.4 execute the same adapter SQL and preserve all nullable and malformed raw columns.
Both HTTP operations remain operations-owned and pending; this capability changes no route, OpenAPI migration status or production traffic.

required_before_phase4h_route_migration: approve and machine-check the operations-to-catalog API dependency direction
implement the complete shared global-gate and role behavior
implement both distinct response projections without changing the raw catalog record
match the legacy integer path converter and generic safe failure policy
preserve the endpoint-specific rate limit and side-effect budget
add route delta and OpenAPI migration only after all 46 golden cases pass
acceptance.next_phase4a_work: continue the next catalog-only read after this capability passes full isolated acceptance
